title: spec/engine: `ragPipelines` is listed in PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR, METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS and two runtime maps, yet no stack can declare it — retire the listings (or implement the collection)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pXkgNXVpCn2GZDjyy
Filing gate: ① a declared-but-unreachable collection (declared ≠ enforced), carried from contract review 6717571232 on PR #31375 (out-of-scope finding, escalated to the seat).
Reach: measured by that review on PR #31375's head: `defineStack({ ragPipelines: … })` is refused (the stack schema declares no `ragPipelines` key), while four registries list it. The gate `scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs` waives it as "DRIFT, recorded not blessed (#6242 row 2)" — and #6242 is closed, so the drift has no open carrier.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `ragPipelines` → 10 hits, `rag_pipeline` → 7 hits; the only open hit is #30803 (bare-name phase 1, unrelated). #6242 (closed) and #2657 (closed, kinds B/C) are the history.
Reader: the lane triage assigns (the listings sit in `packages/spec` and `packages/objectql`, so the spec red line applies); dispatched from `pm:queue`.

## 维护者速读

- **问题：** `ragPipelines` 被四张表当成一种可声明的元数据集合（spec 的复数→单数映射、引擎的集合键表、metadata 插件和 runtime 各一份），但 `defineStack` 根本不接受这个键，作者写不出来。声明了却到不了，是「声明 ≠ 兑现」。
- **影响面：** 今天没有用户受害（写不进去）；风险在于 AI 或作者读到这些表，以为平台支持 RAG 管道集合。
- **需要您做的：** 无。按「零拉动 ⇒ 退役」默认走退役；若您希望实现成真正的集合，那是新能力，会另立决策卡。

## Today (`origin/main` `d0512c2f`+, measured by `git grep -n ragPipelines`)

- `packages/spec/src/meta-spelling/manifest-collection-spelling.ts:93` — `ragPipelines: 'rag_pipeline'` in `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` (a published spec export), and its generated copy `meta-url-data.generated.ts:40`.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts:4078` — `'ragPipelines'` in `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS`.
- `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts:197` — `ragPipelines: 'rag_pipeline'`.
- `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts:507` — `'ragPipelines'` in the app-payload probe list.
- `scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs` — four waiver rows naming `ragPipelines` (`:528`, `:610`, `:645`, `:716`).
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-schemas.ts:232` — "`rag_pipeline` is deliberately NOT bound: it has no stack collection to take a schema from".

## Task (retire route, the default under zero pull)

- [ ] Remove `ragPipelines` from every listing above (and regenerate the generated spelling file); drop the four waiver rows so the gate holds the maps to the schema with no exception for it.
- [ ] Measure first that nothing reads `rag_pipeline` as a live kind (a `/meta/rag_pipeline` read, a stored item, the URL-spelling contract); if anything does, stop and report — that becomes a decision card (implement vs retire), not this card.
- [ ] Changeset per published package touched; removing a key from a published spec export is a narrowing, so the PR owes a contract-review-tier review before the queue.

`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` · `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` (only if the dev's measurement shows a reachable reader; otherwise `none`, since no stack can carry the key today).

Suggested-grade: p3 · inert today (no stack reaches it), costs only a misleading declaration.
